hooks.command: for r in "$(command -v rootwhy 2>/dev/null)" "$HOME/.local/bin/rootwhy"; do [ -n "$r" ] && [ -x "$r" ] || continue; case $("$r" --version 2>/dev/null) in 'rootwhy 3.'*) exec "$r" hook;; esac; done; echo "rootwhy plugin: rootwhy 3.x not found (PATH or ~/.local/bin) — bare sudo is not checked; install: https://github.com/DragonKing026/rootwhy#installation" >&2; exit 1
